Process the lm object

Source: R/processLM-process-lm.R
ProcessLM.Rd

Process the lm object

Usage

ProcessLM(object)

Arguments

object

Object of class lm.

Value

Returns a list with the following elements:

call

lm() function call.

object

Object of class lm.

X

Model matrix (\(1, X_{1}, \dots, X_{p}\) ).

x

Data matrix (\(Y, X_{1}, \dots, X_{p}\) ).

varnames

Variable names of the model matrix.

xnames

Variable names of the regressors in the model matrix.

dims

Dimensions of the model matrix.

n

Sample size.

p

Number of regressors.

k

k = p + 1.

q

Length of the parameters in the covariance structure.

df

n - k degrees of freedom.

mu

Mean vector of the model matrix.

sigmacap

Covariance matrix of the model matrix.

vechsigmacap

Half-vectorization of the covariance matrix of the model matrix.

sigmacapx

Covariance matrix of the regressors in the model matrix.

vechsigmacapx

Half-vectorization of the covariance matrix of the regressors in the model matrix.

sigma

Standard deviation vector of the model matrix.

sigmacap_consistent

Consistent estimate of the covariance matrix of the model matrix.

vechsigmacap_consistent

Half-vectorization of the consistent estimate of the covariance matrix of the model matrix.

pinv_of_dcap

Moore-Penrose inverse of the duplication matrix.

rhocap

Correlation matrix of the model matrix.

coef

Vector of intercept and partial regression slopes.

beta0

Intercept.

beta

Vector of partial regression slopes.

sigmasq

Error variance.

theta

Parameters in the covariance structure, that is, beta, sigmasq, vechsigmacapx.

betastar

Vector of standardized regression slopes.

scor

Vector of semipartial correlations (equal to betastar when p = 1).

pcor

Vector of squared partial correlations (equal to the R-squared when p = 1).

rsq

Vector of the R-squared and the adjusted R-squared.

dif_beta

Differences of partial regression slopes (NA when p = 1).

dif_betastar

Differences of standardized partial regression slopes.

dif_idx

Differences index.

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

object <- lm(QUALITY ~ NARTIC + PCTGRT + PCTSUPP, data = nas1982)
ProcessLM(object = object)
